en: A black‑and‑white view of a hilltop castle complex surrounded by dense forest. The castle sits on a rocky cliff with steep rock faces in the foreground. The complex includes several large, simple-roofed buildings and towers with stepped gables and one slender spire, typical of Central European castles. Additional manor-style houses are visible along the ridge to the right. The sky is blank and overexposed. No visible caption or border text appears on the front.
